state.durability.local_only.label: Only on this Mac
state.durability.local_only.explainer: This version hasn't reached your server yet. If this Mac is lost, so is this progress.
state.durability.local_only.voiceover: Saved {time}. Only on this Mac — it has not reached your server yet.
state.durability.waiting.label: Waiting to copy
state.durability.waiting.explainer: Your server isn't reachable right now. This copies over on its own as soon as it is.
state.durability.waiting.voiceover: Saved {time}. Waiting to copy to your server. It will copy on its own.
state.durability.on_server.label: On your server
state.durability.on_server.explainer: Stored on your server as well as on this Mac.
state.durability.on_server.voiceover: Saved {time}. On your server and on this Mac.
state.position.current.label: You are here
state.position.current.voiceover: You are here. {title} continues from this version, saved {time}.
state.provenance.restored.label: Restored here {date}
state.provenance.restored.explainer: You brought this version back on {date}, from {device}.
state.lineage.separate_version.label: Separate version
state.lineage.separate_version.explainer: This version and the one from {device} both continue from {time}. Neither has been changed.
state.lineage.separate_version.voiceover: Separate version, saved {time} on {device}. It has not been merged with the version from {other device}. Both are kept.
rollup.header.only_on_this_mac: Latest save is only on this Mac.
rollup.header.waiting_to_copy: Latest save is waiting to copy to your server.
rollup.header.on_server: Latest save is on your server.
rollup.no_saves_body: Play {title} and your progress will show up here.
rollup.muted_line_singular: 1 earlier version is only on this Mac.
rollup.muted_line_plural: {N} earlier versions are only on this Mac.
rollup.footnote: Your server holds these versions. Backing up the server itself is separate.
readiness.save_row.ready: Your progress is here and on your server.
readiness.save_row.ready_offline: Your progress is here. It'll copy to your server when it's reachable.
readiness.save_row.warning_not_uploaded: This Mac has your progress, but your server hasn't got it yet.
readiness.save_row.warning_server_newer: Your server has newer progress, from {device}, {relative time}. Playing now continues from what's on this Mac.
readiness.save_row.warning_two_versions: Two versions of your progress are waiting for your decision.
blocker.save_directory.title: Playstead can't write this game's saves.
blocker.save_directory.finding: Nothing has been lost — your saved progress is still on your server. Playstead needs to be able to write to this game's save folder before it starts the game.
blocker.save_directory.voiceover: Blocked. Playstead can't write this game's saves. Your progress is safe on your server. Activate Repair save folder to fix it.
launch.restored_into_emptiness.title: Picked up from your {deviceName} save.
launch.restored_into_emptiness.body: Saved {relative time} on {deviceName}. Nothing on this Mac was replaced.
launch.kept_uncaptured.title: Kept the save already on this Mac.
launch.kept_uncaptured.body: Playstead found saved progress here it hadn't recorded yet, so it saved a copy before starting.
launch.starting_fresh.title: Starting fresh on this Mac.
launch.starting_fresh.body: Newer progress from {deviceName} hasn't downloaded here yet. It's safe on your server and nothing will be overwritten.
launch.diverged_pre_play.title: Two versions of your progress.
launch.diverged_pre_play.body: Playing now continues the version on this Mac. The other version stays exactly as it is.
attention.item_title: Two versions of your progress in {title}
attention.item_body: You played {title} on {Origin A} and {Origin B} without them syncing in between. Both versions are saved. Nothing has been overwritten.
attention.item_body_plural: You played {title} on {N} devices without them syncing in between. All {N} versions are saved. Nothing has been overwritten.
attention.grouped_header: Two versions of your progress in {N} games
compare.subtitle: {title} — both versions are safe. Pick the one to continue from, or keep both.
compare.subtitle_plural: {title} — all {N} versions are safe. Pick the one to continue from, or keep them all.
compare.side_line2: You played {duration} here since these split
compare.side_line2_no_sessions: No recorded play here since these split
compare.clock_caveat: {Origin} reported a time that doesn't line up with when this version reached your server. Times from that Mac may be wrong.
compare.not_downloaded: {title} isn't downloaded on this Mac. You can still choose and export.
compare.keep_both_explainer: Both versions stay in your library. This Mac keeps playing the {Origin} version.
result.after_choosing: Continuing from {Origin}. The {Other origin} version is still here — you can switch to it anytime.
result.after_choosing_plural: Continuing from {Origin}. The other {N−1} versions are still here — you can switch to any of them anytime.
result.after_keeping_both: Keeping both. This Mac plays the {Origin} version. Neither version will be removed.
result.after_switching_back: Continuing from {Origin} again. The {Other origin} version is still here.
result.export_result: Exported {title} — {Origin}, {date}. The folder has the exact save file and a manifest listing what's inside.
result.launch_line: This Mac is playing the {Origin} version. The other version is untouched.
result.console_after_choosing: Continuing from {Origin}. Your Macs will use this version the next time they connect.
result.console_after_keeping_both: Keeping both. Each Mac keeps playing the version it already has.
danger.escalated.title: Your progress can't reach your server.
danger.escalated.body: The last {N} versions of {title} are only on this Mac, and this won't fix itself: {reason}. Your progress is safe here in the meantime.
danger.interruptive.title: This is the only copy of your progress.
danger.interruptive.body: {N} versions of {title} are only on this Mac and nowhere else. Continuing removes them for good.
